overview:
INEX ONE is the leading expert network marketplace — a SaaS platform that aggregates 170+ expert networks and survey providers into a single interface. Founded in 2018 in Stockholm by a team of ex-McKinsey consultants and tech entrepreneurs, the platform enables consulting firms, private equity teams, asset managers, and corporations to centralize expert call management, survey projects, and knowledge repositories across multiple expert network providers.

Rather than competing with expert networks, INEX ONE sits on top of them as an orchestration layer. Clients use the platform to send project briefs to multiple networks simultaneously, track expert interactions, manage compliance workflows, and analyze spend across providers. This meta-platform model gives buyers visibility into which networks perform best for specific topics and geographies, enabling data-driven vendor management.

INEX ONE has grown rapidly, reaching 104M SEK (~$10M) in annual revenue by end of 2024 and earning a spot as #136 on the Financial Times' list of Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies 2025. The company also publishes the definitive annual report on expert network market sizing, establishing itself as the industry's leading independent analyst.

history.narrative:
INEX ONE was founded in 2018 by four co-founders: Max Friberg and Filip Gruvstad (both ex-McKinsey consultants) along with Josefine Vinberg and Mehdi Rejraji (both from tech backgrounds). The founding team identified a fragmentation problem in the expert network industry — corporate buyers were juggling relationships with multiple networks, each with its own portal, compliance process, and invoicing system. INEX ONE set out to build a single marketplace that would unify the experience.

The company raised a $3M seed round in August 2021, attracting a remarkable roster of investors including McKinsey, BCG, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, Advent International, Triton Partners, and Curitas Ventures. Board members included Richard Thornton (former CCO and deputy CEO at Cint, the survey technology company), Bradford Brown and Ajay Gupta (both McKinsey Senior Partner emeriti), and Accent Capital Partners. The diversity of investors from across the consulting and PE ecosystem validated the platform's neutral marketplace positioning.

Since then, INEX ONE has scaled to serve 200+ client firms working with an ever-expanding roster of expert networks. The company's annual Expert Network Market Size report has become the industry standard reference, with the 2025 edition revealing that the global expert network industry surpassed $2.5 billion in 2024.

aiPlatform.narrative: INEX ONE's technology platform is designed as a marketplace orchestration layer. The platform uses AI-powered search to help clients find the right expert networks for specific topics, geographies, and methodologies. Intelligent routing algorithms analyze historical performance data to recommend which networks are most likely to deliver high-quality experts for a given brief. The platform integrates directly with network APIs where available, streamlining the workflow from brief submission through expert delivery and call scheduling. Analytics dashboards provide real-time visibility into network performance, spend, and compliance status across all providers.

Intelligent network routing based on historical performance data

API integrations with major expert network platforms
Centralized billing and invoicing across all network providers

complianceExtended.narrative: INEX ONE was designed from inception as a compliance-first platform. The centralized compliance dashboard provides a single view across all expert network interactions regardless of provider, enabling regulated clients — particularly in private equity and asset management — to maintain consistent compliance standards. The platform tracks cooling-off periods, manages conflict-of-interest declarations, and provides audit trails for all interactions. By centralizing compliance monitoring, INEX ONE helps clients avoid the risk of inconsistent policies across different network providers.
highlights: Centralized compliance dashboard across 170+ expert networks
Unified cooling-off period tracking across all providers
Complete audit trail for all expert interactions across networks
Compliance reporting for regulated industries (PE, asset management)
Consistent MNPI policy enforcement across multiple network providers

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: INEX ONE serves as a compliance orchestration layer for clients who engage multiple expert networks. The platform's value proposition is particularly strong for regulated buyers in private equity and asset management, where consistent compliance documentation across all network interactions is critical. By centralizing monitoring, INEX ONE reduces the compliance burden that grows with each additional network relationship.

clientFit.narrative: INEX ONE is purpose-built for organizations that work with multiple expert networks and need a centralized way to manage those relationships. The platform delivers the most value to high-volume buyers who can leverage spend analytics and network performance data to optimize their expert network portfolio. Smaller organizations using only one or two networks may find less value in the aggregation layer.
